concerns.text: "streams polymer degradation records from the open **WebBook** CSV on Hugging Face" – the cited dataset does not reliably contain curated degradation pathway labels for polyesters. FR‑001 requires a rule‑based synthetic label distribution (or at least matching class frequencies within 10 % tolerance) when labels are missing, yet the plan chooses to exclude unlabeled records entirely, violating the functional requirement and making the dataset inappropriate for the research question.

"evaluates on an external open‑source validation set (if available)" – FR‑010 mandates evaluation on an external validation set of ≥ 30 experimentally verified polymer degradation records. The plan makes this optional (“if available”), providing no guarantee that the required external dataset will be present, thus failing to satisfy the mandatory requirement.
